name: Firstword
description: An original brief-writing SaaS with an immediate composer, editable structured document, original starters, and Markdown export.

notes.layout: centered working composer, large three-view product demonstration, sticky workflow panels, filterable starter dossiers, enhanced editor
notes.motion: product-demo state transitions, scroll-linked workflow selection, staged panel arrivals, directional arrows, reduced-motion fallback
notes.interaction: arrange notes into a local brief, choose starters, edit every section, preview Markdown, copy and download the result
notes.provenance: Original three-page SaaS study with its own identity, composition, writing, generated asset, and deterministic local brief workflow. No reference source or assets included.
